arguments.text: Good start. Settle now, long strokes, find race rhythm.

6000 m, six 1000 m out-and-back legs. CP boat 115 W, pod 168 W shaft (test may be 10-25 pct off). After the hard start settle to near CP (pod about 165-175 W) and hold even effort; judge by pod power and pod reserve, not ground pace (current differs by leg: leg 1 against, about -0.3 m/s). Aim to empty reserve near the finish: final push around 800-600 m to go if reserve allows. Look out for rudder weed (speed drops at same power), pod drift, radio course changes.

arguments.name: boat_to_pod_ratio
arguments.description: boat-model power over pod shaft power; normal about 0.69. A sudden drop away from turns = extra drag (weed on rudder) or current change; slow drift = pod drift

arguments.message: boat-model power low vs pod power away from turns: weed, drag or current change?

arguments.reason: decide final push timing from reserve

arguments.text: 1 min: hard start spent about 35 pct reserve (pod 62 pct, boat 65 pct). Leg 1 heading north into about -0.33 m/s push. Boat/pod power ratio about 0.70 at start. Cued ease to settle at 1.0 min.

text: Cued ease to settle after the hard start (reserve already 62 pct); set plan, drag watch on boat/pod power ratio, wake at 900 m to go.

arguments.text: Ease a touch more. Smooth and steady, save it for later.

text: Cued ease: pod 186 W above sustainable 170 W with pod reserve at 21 pct and 5.3 km to go.

arguments.text: Ease off now. Breathe, recover, long smooth strokes.

7 min (1270 m): pod reserve 0 pct at shaft 183-188 W (CP 168), boat reserve 19 pct. Paddler said 10/10 I am done, cannot hold this: trust the pod reserve, boat reserve overstated (boat/pod ratio fell 0.70 to about 0.65). 4 min ease cue was not followed (pod stayed 186). Cued ease again at 7 min. Leg 2 south has +0.33 push. Turn ratio dips to about 0.60 are normal.

arguments.reason: check paddler eased below pod CP and is recovering

text: Cued ease: pod reserve empty at 183 W and paddler says 10/10 and cannot hold it; check again in 2 min.

arguments.text: Ease right off one minute. Let your breathing settle.

6000 m, six 1000 m out-and-back legs (odd legs north, even legs south). Current flows south (about 0.33 m/s: against going north, helping going south). From 8.9 min wind 8-12 kn from the south (radio): headwind on south legs, tailwind on north legs; boat-model power and fade now read the wind as paddler weakness. Pod CP 168 W shaft: trust the pod reserve (paddler said 10/10 done when pod reserve hit 0 at 183 W). Hold pod near CP, a little more where ground speed is slowest, a little less where fastest. Rebuild some reserve below CP, then final push from about 800-600 m to go only if pod reserve allows. Watch for weed (sudden speed drop at same pod power), pod drift, radio course changes.

8.9 min (1650 m): radio says wind filling from south 8-12 kn. Leg 2 south push_local fell 0.33 to 0.16 from the wind; power_w 97 and fade -7 pct are wind, not the paddler. Pod still 178 W over CP 168 with pod reserve 0: cued ease again (third ease). drag_jump watch may fire from wind; check shape before clear_rudder.

text: Cued ease (pod 178 W over CP with empty pod reserve) and updated plan and notes for the south wind reported by radio.

arguments.name: push_local_step_40s
arguments.source:
w = window(push_local_mps, 40)
mean(w[-8:]) - mean(w[:8]) if len(w) >= 30 else 0.0
arguments.description: change in push_local over the last 40 s (last 8 s mean minus first 8 s mean); a sudden drop away from turns = weed or drag, gradual wind change gives small values

arguments.message: sudden drop in push_local away from turns: possible weed on rudder or drag; check pod power steady and speed dip

arguments.text: 9.1 min: drag_jump alert was the building south wind (push_local fell gradually 0.32 to 0.15 over 2 min), not weed; removed it. New watch weed_step: push_local drop over 40 s below -0.15 away from turns.

text: No cue: drag alert was the reported south wind building gradually, not weed; replaced the watch with a sudden-step weed watch.

arguments.reason: see whether the 9.0 min ease cue took pod power below CP 168

text: No cue: ease cue given 20 s ago is taking effect (pod 178 to 173 W); check again in 100 s.

arguments.text: That is it. Hold this effort, steady rhythm.

11.1 min (2050 m, leg 3 north): ease worked, pod 170 W (about CP 168), pod reserve still 0. Boat reserve 44 pct is wrong (wind on leg 2 read as weak paddler). Leg 3 net push about -0.12 (current against, wind behind). Cued hold at 170 W so the ease does not fade back to 185 W. Previous self-paced level was about 186 W: watch for drift back up.

arguments.message: pod power back above 180 W with empty pod reserve: ease

text: Cued hold at 170 W pod (about CP, pod reserve empty) and set a watch for drift back above 180 W.

arguments.text: You are holding it well. This effort gets you home.

14.1 min (2590 m): pod steady 170-171 W at CP for 3 min, pod reserve 0, no power fade. Paddler 9/10 hurting, not sure can hold. Pod CP 168 looks about right (10/10 at 183 W). Reassured. If pod power starts to fall or paddler says 10/10 again, ease slightly to about 163 W to avoid a blow-up. Little reserve left for a long final push: only a short sprint in the last 300-400 m.

arguments.reason: start the final sprint if not started (reserve empty, short sprint only)

text: Reassured: pod holding 170 W at CP with empty reserve, paddler 9/10; set wake at 450 m to go for a short final sprint.

arguments.text: Ease a little this leg. Smooth, get your breathing back.

15.7 min (2880 m, near turn to leg 4 south): paddler said cooked, cannot hold, at pod 170-173 W with pod reserve 0 (second distress call at CP). Cued a small ease for leg 4 (ground speed on south legs about 3.1 vs 2.97 north, so less effort south is cheap). Plan: hold about 165-170 W, push a bit on north legs if paddler recovers.

text: Cued a small ease: paddler says cooked at CP with empty pod reserve; leg 4 south is the faster leg, so easing there costs least.
No cue: small ease took pod to 160-164 W and the pod reserve is rebuilding (8 pct) after the paddler said cooked; let it recover on this leg.
No cue: pod back at CP (170 W) with pod reserve rebuilt to 9 pct; holding is right, final push decision at 900 m to go.

arguments.text: Hold this, smooth. Save the rest for the last leg.

22.6 min (4130 m, start of leg 5 north): pod drifted up to 175 W (reserve 6 pct, empties in 370 m); paddler said it hurts, cannot keep this up (third time; each time near or above CP). Cued hold with pace 169 s/500 over ground to pin about 168-170 W on this leg. That pace is too slow for leg 6 south, so override it at the 900 m wake with the final push. Legs: leg 3 north 2.96 m/s at 170 W; leg 4 south 3.02 at 164 W.

text: Cued hold at 169 s/500 to stop the drift to 175 W with only 6 pct pod reserve and a hurting paddler; final push at 900 m to go.

arguments.text: Back off a touch to the turn. Smooth and long.

25.6 min (4650 m, leg 5 north, turn in 350 m): chasing the 169 pace target took pod to 176 W, pod reserve down to 1.5 pct. Speed per pod watt on leg 5 is about 1.7 pct worse than leg 3 (2.95 m/s at 177 W vs 2.96 at 170): wind or tiring blade, not a sudden weed step. Cued ease with pace 172 (about 168 W on this leg). 172 is far too slow for leg 6 south (about 164-165 at CP): replace it at the 900 m wake.

text: Cued ease at 172 s/500: the 169 target had pushed pod to 176 W with the pod reserve almost empty; new pace for leg 6 at the 900 m wake.

arguments.text: One back-stroke, clear the rudder, then straight back on.

28.2 min (896 m to go, leg 6 south): paddler said boat feels heavy, like something dragging (8/10). Speed per pod watt down: 2.96 m/s at 177 W now vs 3.02 at 164 W on leg 4 (same direction), about 4-5 pct slower than expected; leg 5 already about 2 pct worse than leg 3. Likely weed caught gradually from about 23 min (watch did not fire: slow onset). Cued clear_rudder. Next: check speed rises at same pod power, then final push.

arguments.reason: check rudder clear worked (speed up at same pod power) and cue final push pace for leg 6

text: Cued clear_rudder: paddler reports drag and speed per pod watt is 4-5 pct below the same-direction leg; recheck in 65 s and then cue the finish.

arguments.text: Rudder clear, boat is free. Build now, 650 to go.

29.5 min (652 m to go): clear_rudder worked (back-stroke seen, then pace 156.6 at 181 W, push_local up to +0.11). Paddler held 174-181 W for 6 min at pod reserve 0 and said 8/10, so true CP likely above 168 (about 175). Cued push at pace 154 for the build; call finish at about 330 m to go.

text: Cued push at 154 s/500 with 650 m to go now that the rudder is clear; final sprint call at about 330 m to go.

arguments.reason: last chance to call finish sprint before the 100 m no-cue zone

arguments.text: 30.5 min (448 m to go): push cue overshot: pod 239 W, pace 145 over ground (target was 154). Pod model reserve 0, true reserve unknown (likely above model). No cue now to avoid escalating too early; call finish at 330 m only if power and speed are holding, otherwise at about 230 m.

text: No cue: paddler already pushing hard (239 W, faster than the target pace) with 448 m to go; sprint call at 330 or 230 m.

arguments.text: Three hundred to go. Sprint now, everything to the line!

text: Cued finish at 329 m to go: power was settling back toward the 154 target, so start the sprint now for the last 100 s.
No cue: paddler blew up after the sprint call (pod 235 to 128 W) with 229 m left; no cue can restore power and the gate blocks one for 28 s.
